name: @samline/scroll-lock
description: Page scroll locking for modals, drawers and menus: nested locks, scrollbar gap compensation, scroll position restoration and the iOS Safari workaround, for vanilla JavaScript and plain HTML.
author: Samuel Olvera (samline)

scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run build && bun run size && bun run test:e2e
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage
scripts.site:build: node site-tools/assets.mjs && bun run --cwd docs build && bun run --cwd landing build && node site-tools/assemble.mjs && node site-tools/check-site.mjs
scripts.site:check: node site-tools/assets.mjs && node site-tools/check-config.mjs && bun run site:check:design && bun run --cwd landing check && bun run --cwd docs check
scripts.site:format: prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-astro --write landing docs/src docs/scripts shared site-tools site-tests site-e2e skills playwright.site.config.ts project.config.json content-audit.json design-reference.json SITE.md --ignore-path .site-prettierignore
scripts.site:format:check: prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-astro --check landing docs/src docs/scripts shared site-tools site-tests site-e2e skills playwright.site.config.ts project.config.json content-audit.json design-reference.json SITE.md --ignore-path .site-prettierignore
scripts.site:verify: bun run site:check && bun run site:format:check && bun run site:test && bun run site:test:adaptation && bun run site:build && bun run site:check:identity && bun run site:check:content && bun run site:test:browser
